meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Taxing Expedition
meta.description: The twisting tracks below the high wall, the unyielding cries in the struggle.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth, near the main energy tower.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth, near the main energy tower.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth, near the main energy tower.

units.rawText: Hordes of densely packed Low-Order Entropics are milling around at the base of the energy tower. A golden arrow parts the purple sea, and Atlas follows closely behind it, carving a path with his greatsword.
units.displayText: Hordes of densely packed Low-Order Entropics are milling around at the base of the energy tower. A golden arrow parts the purple sea, and Atlas follows closely behind it, carving a path with his greatsword.

spans.text: Hordes of densely packed Low-Order Entropics are milling around at the base of the energy tower. A golden arrow parts the purple sea, and Atlas follows closely behind it, carving a path with his greatsword.

units.rawText: Now!
units.displayText: Now!

spans.text: Now!

units.rawText: I've successfully connected to the energy tower core, commencing decryption!
units.displayText: I've successfully connected to the energy tower core, commencing decryption!

spans.text: I've successfully connected to the energy tower core, commencing decryption!

units.rawText: A formless barrier envelopes Electra and me. Alcyone flaps her ruined wings and flies at low altitudes, using her superior mobility to eliminate the Low-Order Entropics attempting to approach us.
units.displayText: A formless barrier envelopes Electra and me. Alcyone flaps her ruined wings and flies at low altitudes, using her superior mobility to eliminate the Low-Order Entropics attempting to approach us.

spans.text: A formless barrier envelopes Electra and me. Alcyone flaps her ruined wings and flies at low altitudes, using her superior mobility to eliminate the Low-Order Entropics attempting to approach us.

units.rawText: Skree!
units.displayText: Skree!

spans.text: Skree!

units.rawText: You shall not pass—Judgement Arrow!
units.displayText: You shall not pass—Judgement Arrow!

spans.text: You shall not pass—Judgement Arrow!

units.rawText: The purple fades under the golden light, and then a crimson figure emerges—
units.displayText: The purple fades under the golden light, and then a crimson figure emerges—

spans.text: The purple fades under the golden light, and then a crimson figure emerges—

units.rawText: Surprised, shrimpy?
units.displayText: Surprised, shrimpy?

spans.text: Surprised, shrimpy?

units.rawText: <size=40>Clang!</size>
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: As the High-Order Entropic closes the distance to Alcyone, a greatsword crashes down between the two of them.
units.displayText: As the High-Order Entropic closes the distance to Alcyone, a greatsword crashes down between the two of them.

spans.text: As the High-Order Entropic closes the distance to Alcyone, a greatsword crashes down between the two of them.

units.rawText: I'm your opponent here. Alcyone, go take care of those Low-Order Entropics.
units.displayText: I'm your opponent here. Alcyone, go take care of those Low-Order Entropics.

spans.text: I'm your opponent here. Alcyone, go take care of those Low-Order Entropics.

units.rawText: Hahahaha, a new opponent, this is fun!
units.displayText: Hahahaha, a new opponent, this is fun!

spans.text: Hahahaha, a new opponent, this is fun!

units.rawText: I won't let you get away this time!
units.displayText: I won't let you get away this time!

spans.text: I won't let you get away this time!

units.rawText: Relax, we weren't planning on running—Holy Blade of Severance!
units.displayText: Relax, we weren't planning on running—Holy Blade of Severance!

spans.text: Relax, we weren't planning on running—Holy Blade of Severance!

units.rawText: The High-Order Entropic rushes in with longsword in hand. Atlas blocks the attack with his greatsword, the impact throwing his opponent back a couple of steps.
units.displayText: The High-Order Entropic rushes in with longsword in hand. Atlas blocks the attack with his greatsword, the impact throwing his opponent back a couple of steps.

spans.text: The High-Order Entropic rushes in with longsword in hand. Atlas blocks the attack with his greatsword, the impact throwing his opponent back a couple of steps.

units.rawText: Heh... Don't think you'll be able to take another step forward with me around.
units.displayText: Heh... Don't think you'll be able to take another step forward with me around.

spans.text: Heh... Don't think you'll be able to take another step forward with me around.

units.rawText: Hahahahaha—That's right, this is it! This is the fight I've been waiting for!
units.displayText: Hahahahaha—That's right, this is it! This is the fight I've been waiting for!

spans.text: Hahahahaha—That's right, this is it! This is the fight I've been waiting for!

units.rawText: The red-haired High-Order Entropic licks up the purple fluid on her forearm and excitedly raises her longsword again.
units.displayText: The red-haired High-Order Entropic licks up the purple fluid on her forearm and excitedly raises her longsword again.

spans.text: The red-haired High-Order Entropic licks up the purple fluid on her forearm and excitedly raises her longsword again.

units.rawText: Humph, indeed... I haven't fought like this in a while.
units.displayText: Humph, indeed... I haven't fought like this in a while.

spans.text: Humph, indeed... I haven't fought like this in a while.

units.rawText: Fantastic! You're way better than that shrimp and her big sister!
units.displayText: Fantastic! You're way better than that shrimp and her big sister!

spans.text: Fantastic! You're way better than that shrimp and her big sister!

units.rawText: I wonder what kind of sounds your body will make when I tear it to shreds!
units.displayText: I wonder what kind of sounds your body will make when I tear it to shreds!

spans.text: I wonder what kind of sounds your body will make when I tear it to shreds!
